title: Credit Review Clause: Collection Review Period for Electric Service by Rate Schedule Seasonal Restores
content:
**Clause.** The late payment charges reviewed when an idle Electric Service by Rate Schedule account is restored are those dated within a collection review period, set from the service account's record:

| Account record | Collection review period |
|---|---|
| Connected less than twelve whole months before the current date | The whole months elapsed since the connect date, counting the month in progress: the late payment charges dated less than one more than that number of whole months before the current date |
| Connected twelve whole months or more, with a returned payment dated less than twelve whole months before the current date | The 12 whole months before the current date |
| Any other account | The whole months elapsed since the idle date: the late payment charges dated less than that number of whole months before the current date |

### Hypothetical cases

| Account | Review period |
|---|---|
| Connected 7 whole months ago | Late payment charges dated less than 8 whole months before the current date |
| Connected 4 years ago, a returned payment 5 months ago | Late payment charges dated less than 12 whole months before the current date |
| Connected 4 years ago, no returned payment in the twelve months, idle for 5 whole months | Late payment charges dated less than 5 whole months before the current date |
